title: Revela: Dense Retriever Learning via Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2506.16552v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dense retrievers play a vital role in accessing external and specialized knowledge to augment language models (LMs). Training dense retrievers typically requires annotated query-document pairs, which are costly to create and scarce in specialized domains (e.g., code) or in complex settings (e.g., requiring reasoning). These practical challenges have sparked growing interest in self-supervised retriever learning. Since LMs are trained to capture token-level dependencies through a self-supervised learning objective (i.e., next token prediction), we can analogously cast retrieval as learning dependencies among chunks of tokens. This analogy naturally leads to the question: How can we adapt self-supervised learning objectives in the spirit of language modeling to train retrievers?   To answer this question, we introduce Revela, a unified and scalable training framework for self-supervised retriever learning via language modeling. R

translated_title: Revela：通过语言建模进行密集检索器学习
translated_abstract: 密集检索器在访问外部和专业知识以增强语言模型（LM）方面发挥着重要作用。训练密集检索器通常需要标注的查询-文档对，这类数据创建成本高昂，且在专业领域（如代码）或复杂场景（如需要推理）中十分稀缺。这些实际挑战激发了人们对自监督检索器学习日益增长的兴趣。由于语言模型通过自监督学习目标（即下一词元预测）来捕捉词元级别的依赖关系，我们可以类似地将检索任务视为学习词元块之间的依赖关系。这一类比自然引出如下问题：我们如何以语言建模的精神调整自监督学习目标来训练检索器？为回答这一问题，我们提出了Revela，一个通过语言建模实现自监督检索器学习的统一且可扩展的训练框架。
tldr: 提出Revela框架，将检索类比为词元块之间的依赖关系学习，通过语言建模式的自监督目标训练密集检索器，从而摆脱对昂贵标注查询-文档对的依赖。
en_tdlr: Revela is a unified and scalable framework that trains dense retrievers self-supervisedly by casting retrieval as learning dependencies among token chunks through language modeling, eliminating the need for costly annotated query-document pairs.
